title: The strategy needs Powerhouse to be explainable in three registers at once
content:
The session captured three framing questions — what is Powerhouse, what can I use it for, and how can I get started — plus a fourth on accessing consultancy services. The answers point to the Powerhouse x NIKO material and the enterprise site, an action for Wouter to update the brief, a capability list of IDP, structured data and business intelligence, and an app development platform, and an action to brush up the tutorials and installation manuals.

The registers are distinct audiences. The consultancy partner needs the capability framing to decide whether it completes their offering; their engineer needs the tutorials to make it work; the end client needs the identity statement. A gap in any one of them breaks the funnel at a different point.

The onboarding action is the least glamorous and probably the most load-bearing: the sequence depends on a partner being able to install and run the thing after the demo convinces them.
description: What is Powerhouse, what can I use it for, and how do I get started — with the brief to be updated and tutorials and installation manuals to be brushed up.
